scientific_integrity: The exact finite-sample formula is obtained from elementary nested Bernoulli occupancy indicators. Uniform two-regime bounds prevent escaping optimizers and, together with locally uniform rare-event asymptotics, prove the sharp constant and localization of every optimizing sequence. Finite exact-rational replay is illustrative rather than a substitute for the analytic theorem.
scientific_limitations: The result optimizes ordinary Pearson correlation only for iid samples with a fixed, equally spaced three-point support and symmetric endpoint probabilities. It does not optimize nonsymmetric probabilities, nonlinear transformations, or finite-n maximizing masses in closed form. Possible implicit prior coverage under rare-event extremal-correlation terminology remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Rare-endpoint maximizers of three-state extreme-order correlation
